metadata.title: Container Core

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for safely executing multiple containerized workloads on shared compute platforms while preserving isolation and platform trust.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Container platforms, shared-kernel execution environments, and container runtime foundations.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Establishes baseline trust boundaries and isolation assumptions in containerized execution environments.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Container platforms assume a trusted virtualized or equivalent execution substrate.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Shared-kernel execution risks and container host considerations.

metadata.remarks: Container Core defines the foundational trust properties required to operate containerized workloads on shared infrastructure. This pattern makes shared-kernel risks, isolation boundaries, and container-layer threat relevance explicit and assertable, without prescribing orchestration, runtime policy, or supply-chain controls.

components.title: Container Workload Isolation
components.description: Prevents unintended interaction or interference between containerized workloads.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Process injection or memory manipulation across container boundaries.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Enforcement of isolation boundaries between container workloads.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Information flow control between container execution domains.

components.title: Container–Host Trust Boundary
components.description: Maintains separation between container workloads and the underlying host operating system.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Container escape to host via kernel or runtime exploitation.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Minimization of host attack surface exposed to containers.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Least functionality for host interfaces exposed to containers.

components.title: Container Lateral Movement Containment
components.description: Limits the ability of a compromised container to move laterally across shared container infrastructure.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Lateral movement between container workloads via shared platform resources.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Containment of east-west movement across containerized workloads.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Boundary protection within shared container platforms.
Identification of exploitable lateral movement paths.
